verdict.rationale: Datadog is an observability platform with AI agents, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question to ask. The evidence only documents Datadog's own official MCP server, which exposes Datadog's tools to other agents. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. No evidence shows Datadog or Bits AI connecting to external MCP servers and using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
